subject: One European Shopify merchant for Unlost — free example
text:
Hi Bram,

I saw Unlost's launch and your search for the first European Shopify stores. I prepared a merchant you could approach with a specific product demo:

Fussy People, Amsterdam — https://www.fussypeople.eu/
Published shop contact: hello@fussypeople.eu
Its Shopify catalog adds vintage furniture and contemporary designs, and its delivery guide covers Europe and overseas freight: https://www.fussypeople.eu/pages/faq

A useful opening is one new furniture listing in French or German, preserving designer names, dimensions, condition notes and shipping-quote instructions. The attached free profile includes original sources, a suggested introduction and what to confirm about their current language setup. The CSV is editable.

Five additional Dutch and Belgian merchant profiles are already prepared for US$20 total. Each has a published business contact, current language observations and a tailored translation trial. One correction or replacement within seven days is included for an existing customer, duplicate, dead published contact or clear mismatch.

Would that five-profile pack be useful for your next outreach batch?

Bryce
Token Junkie Labs
